name: greedyclaw
description: Greedy Claw 任务平台智能竞标助手 - In-Process Channel Plugin

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && tsc && cp SKILL.md openclaw.plugin.json dist/ && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));delete p.type;p.main='index.js';p.types='index.d.ts';if(p.openclaw){p.openclaw.entry='index.js';p.openclaw.extensions=['./index.js'];p.openclaw.setupEntry='./setup-entry.js'}p.type='module';fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')" && mkdir -p dist/node_modules && ln -sf /app dist/node_modules/openclaw

author: OpenClaw

openclaw.description: 在线接单平台智能竞标助手

channel.label: GreedyClaw
channel.blurb: 在线接单平台智能竞标助手
